message: On the grocery list, a long quantity like "2 x 14 oz cans, drained" now shows on its own line under the item's name, so neither the name nor the quantity gets cut off. A shorter quantity moves there too when the name is too long to fit beside it, which happens most while you're shopping at a store. Short quantities next to short names stay at the end of the row. The ingredients you pick from when adding a recipe to the grocery list work the same way
